scripts.build: astro build && cp -r dist/client/* dist/ && echo 'export { default } from "./server/entry.mjs";' > dist/_worker.js
scripts.ci:guard: npm run check && npm run build && npm run test:guard
scripts.deploy:preview: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name grix-website
scripts.deploy:production: npm run ci:guard && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name grix-website --branch main
